response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS qc_count FROM scanqc q JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = q.arcref GROUP BY p.fundflux) SELECT fundflux, qc_count, qc_count * 1.0 / SUM(qc_count) OVER () AS fraction_of_total, qc_count * 1.0 / AVG(qc_count * 1.0) OVER () AS ratio_to_average FROM g

assumptions.assumption: A missing funding source means NULL fundflux, which GROUP BY already places in its own group. Empty strings are not treated as missing.
The average per funding source is the mean of the group counts, with the NULL group included as one group.
